product_one_liner.value: RedTeam provides commercial general contractors with construction-management software to manage bids, budgets, daily logs, documents, and projects from preconstruction through closeout.
product_one_liner.notes: RedTeam’s About page directly describes construction-management software built for commercial general contractors and lists bids, budgets, daily logs, documents, and the project lifecycle.

pricing_page.notes: RedTeam has a public page headed “Pricing” that describes its pricing tiers and active-project-volume pricing, even though prices are not simply listed as fixed amounts.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The cited RedTeam customer stories identify Shaub Construction and CCI Commercial Construction as customers. | named_customers.0: The RedTeam customer-success story is titled Shaub Construction and describes its use of RedTeam. | named_customers.1: The RedTeam customer-success story identifies CCI Commercial Construction and describes RedTeam’s use there.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 98 employees, which falls in the 51–100 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: RedTeam’s company timeline explicitly places its headquarters in Orlando, Florida. | hq_country: The company timeline gives its headquarters as Orlando, Florida, and the company LinkedIn profile identifies its country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: The company timeline identifies RedTeam as founded in 2006.

eng_blog.notes: The Builder Blog index shows practical construction-management and project how-to articles (for example submittals, scheduling, and construction reports), not multiple engineer-authored posts about building RedTeam’s product. The reviewed archive pages therefore support false under the requested definition.

public_docs.notes: RedTeam’s public Help Center lists numerous product collections with hundreds of articles, satisfying the several-articles requirement.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The company’s careers job board was accessible and explicitly stated that there were no jobs posted at the time, so no AI/ML/data-science role was open there.

model_provider.value: AWS (Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Textract for document processing); the specific foundation model is not named.
model_provider.notes: The Allata case study says its AI pipeline built for RedTeam uses AWS Bedrock and Textract. It does not name a particular foundation model, so the answer identifies the disclosed AWS services and notes that limitation.

compliance_certs.notes: RedTeam’s legal privacy policy includes a data-security section but names none of the listed certifications; the cited legal page was checked for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding history describes the February 2022 latest round as Series B. raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports that the latest round was February 2, 2022, well before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025; no newer round is listed.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: RedTeam’s SDR job posting names a Sales Development Representative role, and a recent listing says RedTeam was hiring for that role. This supports current SDR hiring despite a separate careers portal reporting no postings.

launched_6mo.notes: The Builder Blog post dated August 19, 2026 covers RedTeam Flex’s new Submittals experience, an introduced product feature inside the six-month window ending November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A dated announcement states that Connor Schone was appointed Vice President of Finance on July 9, 2026, within the 12 months before November 9, 2026.
